system.description:
You cover your hands in chakra, which being glowing in a light pink hue. A creature you touch regains 2d6 Hit Points. Additionally, at the start of each of the affected creatures turns they regain 1d6 Hit Points.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank increase the cost of the jutsu by 3 and the initial healing by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the healing at the start of each turn by +1d6. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the healing at the start of each turn by +1d6.
